checks.lead: Julia Pastrana (August 1834 – 25 March 1860) was a Mexican singer and exhibition performer who became one of the best-known sideshow performers of the 19th century. Born in Sinaloa, she had generalized hypertrichosis and gingival hyperplasia, conditions that affected her appearance and led to her being exhibited under promotional names including "The Nondescript", "Bear Woman", and "Ape Woman".
